title: The Earthquake in the Town
text:
In March, a strong earthquake shook a small town near the coast. Many houses fell down, and the roads were closed. The local people were frightened, but they helped each other.

Rescue teams arrived the next morning. They used dogs to find people under the broken buildings. The town now has a new emergency plan, so people know what to do next time.

questions.text: When did the earthquake shake the town?
What did the rescue teams use to find people?
How did the local people probably feel after the earthquake?
options: They were angry at the rescue teams.
They were happy about the closed roads.

questions.text: Why does the town have a new emergency plan?
options: So people will be ready for the next earthquake.
Because the houses were built too high.
Because the rescue teams wanted a holiday.
Because the roads were made wider.

vocabulary.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement under the earth
feeling afraid of something that might hurt you
the action of saving people from danger
a serious and sudden situation that needs quick action

paragraph_translations: Mart ayında güçlü bir deprem sahil yakınındaki küçük bir kasabayı sarstı. Birçok ev yıkıldı ve yollar kapatıldı. Yerel halk korkmuştu, ama birbirine yardım etti.

Kurtarma ekipleri ertesi sabah geldi. Yıkılan binaların altındaki insanları bulmak için köpekler kullandılar. Kasabanın artık yeni bir acil durum planı var, bu yüzden insanlar bir dahaki sefere ne yapacaklarını biliyor.
